stem: A print shop uses 0.2 milliliters of ink for each text page and 0.5 milliliters of ink for each photo page. The shop uses all 60 milliliters of ink in a new cartridge to print exactly 150 text pages and \(y\) photo pages. What is the value of \(y\)?
verify:
y = symbols('y')
sol = solve(Eq(Rational(2, 10)*150 + Rational(5, 10)*y, 60), y)
assert sol == [60]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sol
